# Cycle19: quantum entropy and oracle synthesis

Worker pde_gate9; reused parent-verified GPT-6.1 Sol/max. No nested workers, no paid/contact/publication/commit actions. Assigned families273–284. Pinned primary release: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`, released6October2026. All twelve assigned overview entries were read; two manuscripts were read technically in full. This report records internally reconstructed scope, not external validation.

The strongest findings are a reusable four-weight diagonal-form transfer mechanism and exact entropy converses from family273, plus polynomial-accuracy-bit oracle synthesis and a proved sparse-positive-enforcement nontransfer from family283. The new release does not acquire our earlier microscopic memory preparation or an efficient target-dependent Boolean oracle.

## 1. Family273: finite-energy EPnI

Primary: OpenAI, *The entropy photon-number inequality*, manuscript dated24September2026. Full32-page PDF, all substantive TeX sections and reference locations read. Whole finite-energy independent-port proof independently reconstructed in:

`notes/pde_gate9/cycle19/EPnI_RECONSTRUCTION_AND_ENTROPY_CONTRACTION.md`.

No failed load-bearing implication found. Reconstruction includes fixed auxiliary parameter order, quartic regularized attainment, global Gibbs majorant, seventh-moment eigenvector regularity, correct Hessian normalization, the four-weight interpolation, weak ladder convolution, weighted generator/log pairings, exact centered-energy cancellation and the thermal entry recurrence. It does not assume entropy differentiation along an unbounded semigroup or energy convergence in the final compact limit.

Two separately reconstructed bounded gates are available:

- `notes/pde_gate10/cycle19/FOUR_WEIGHT_INTERPOLATION_INDEPENDENT_GATE.md`: PASS for the entire four-weight theorem and thermal substitution. In particular, two Herglotz applications and an affine-slope elimination are required to obtain the derivative Stieltjes representation; anti-Pick behavior alone is insufficient. The linear maps need not commute with the diagonal multipliers, but the source test class must be invariant under finite parameter-tuple multipliers.
- `notes/pde_gate10/cycle19/EPnI_CONSEQUENCES_CONDITIONAL_GATE.md`: conditional PASS for the sharp entropy-energy envelope and the common-β pure-loss region bridge. It supplies neither
